scenario: C — Champion departure, intervention, counterfactual (saas_premium, H1 with action)
narrative: The person who bought us left. Here's what we did, and what would have happened if we hadn't. docs/design/demo-narratives.md §3C

communications.text: CRM contact update: Elena Rossi (VP Data), our primary champion, has left Northwind — her LinkedIn now shows a new role at another company. No successor has been named on the account.

Ravi here — I'm covering the data team on an interim basis. We're going to pause the weekly syncs for now while I get my bearings. I filled in your NPS survey with a 5, honestly because I don't yet know what the platform is doing for us.

Ticket #2291: Third request this week from the analytics team — they are stuck on the scheduled report builder and the permissions model. The people who knew this used to sort it out themselves; now everything comes to me and I'm forwarding it all to you.
Playbook 'exec sponsor rebuild' executed: exec-to-exec intro made between our VP Customer and Tom Becker, and a value review scheduled with Ravi and the new data leadership for next month.

Some news — I've been confirmed as Head of Data. The value review landed well with my leadership and I'd like to restart the weekly syncs; I'm now the owner of the platform relationship on our side and I'm keen to make it work.
Tom Becker (CFO) joined the renewal value review and asked detailed questions about the ROI model; he said he wants the renewal decision grounded in that analysis and will stay involved.

events.title: Renewal secured at -8% — Northwind Analytics
events.evidence: Renewal order form dated 2026-04-25; seats reduced 8% vs arc expected path of full churn

communications.text: I'm moving into a new role on the commercial side next month, so I'll be handing the platform over. Grace Okafor is taking over Operations and will be your contact from the 1st — I've already walked her through where we are.
Grace ran the QBR herself, confirmed there is no change in plans for the platform, and asked about the roadmap for the routing module.
I recommended you to a peer at another logistics company last week — they may reach out. Happy to be a reference if it helps.
Luis Ortega (Head of BI) announced he is leaving Cascade at the end of the month; no successor has been named and the BI team reports to the CFO in the interim.
Sorry, we need to cancel Thursday's sync again — second time this month. We don't have an owner for the platform right now; I'll reach out when someone is confirmed.
Routine monthly review with Pat: walked through the dashboards and the open requests; nothing flagged on either side and no concerns raised.
